title: Beekeeping courses often start in winter, ready for the bees in spring
alt: Two white wooden beehives stand in rough grass among bare young trees beside a wire fence.

posts.facebook:
A colony of honey bees is something you learn to read through the year, from swarms in spring to winter food stores. Local beekeeping associations run taster days and beginners' courses and can often find you a mentor, so you handle bees before you buy anything.

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/take-up-beekeeping/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do
